name: Otterbein University
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts university in Westerville, OH. Nationally recognized regional university with reported career outcomes exceeding national averages; 100% of traditional first-year students receive institutional aid.
financial_aid: As NCAA D3, no athletic scholarships are offered. Institutional aid is need- and merit-based: renewable four-year merit scholarships (financial need not a factor), FAFSA-based need aid (grants, loans, work-study), the statewide Opportunity Scholarship Gap Award covering direct tuition for qualifying Ohio residents (income <=$60,000 or Pell recipients), and a No Loan to Tuition program for Ohio residents receiving both the Pell grant and Ohio College Opportunity Grant. Otterbein reports awarding over $35 million yearly in merit scholarships and grants.
facilities_notes: NCAA Division III program competing in the Ohio Athletic Conference. Specific softball facility details not confirmed on official pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III women's softball program competing in the Ohio Athletic Conference (OAC).
notes: Data sourced live from otterbeincardinals.com softball coaches page (/sports/softball/coaches/2025) and roster page (/sports/softball/roster), and otterbein.edu financial aid/affordability pages, checked 2026-07. Tuition figure $37,516 is 2026-2027 annual tuition (total cost of attendance approx. $51,714 including housing/meals/fees). As a D3 program, no athletic scholarships are awarded (scholarship_count = null).
